title: MEDAC — Master Engineering Design and Construction

hero.subtitle: MASTER ENGINEERING DESIGN & CONSTRUCTION
hero.description: MEDAC is a multidisciplinary drawing and design consultancy delivering precision drafting, structural detailing and FEED studies across infrastructure, energy, mining and water sectors.

services.title: Drafting and design, discipline by discipline.
services.description: From concept sketches to construction-ready issue sets, every drawing is coordinated, version controlled and built for the field.

items.title: Piping & Mechanical Drafting
items.description: Isometrics, P&IDs, GA layouts and 3D plant modeling for process and mechanical systems.

items.title: Structural & Civil Drawings
items.description: Reinforced concrete detailing, steel layouts and civil infrastructure plans.

items.title: Electrical & Instrumentation
items.description: Schematics, loop diagrams, cable routing and panel layouts.

items.title: FEED
items.description: Front-end engineering design: feasibility studies, conceptual layouts and preliminary engineering.

items.title: Project Coordination
items.description: Document control, drawing registers, version tracking and inter-discipline coordination.

industries.title: Sectors we design for.
industries.description: Multidisciplinary teams matched to the standards and risk profile of each sector.

who_we_are.heading: Who We Are
who_we_are.text: MEDAC is a multidisciplinary drawing and design company serving diverse sectors including infrastructure, energy, mining, oil & gas and water treatment.

mission.heading: Mission
mission.text: To combine technical precision with creative engineering for sustainable, client-focused outcomes.

director.name: Kgolagano Mogwera
director.quote: Founded and directed by Kgolagano Mogwera, MEDAC is built on a foundation of expertise, innovation and reliability.

contact.title: Let's start your drawing set.
contact.subtitle: Reach out with your scope and we'll come back with a plan and timeline.
